Every proof in this paper possesses a corresponding Lean 4 formalisation, except where explicitly citing external references for large prior results. 739 of 750 (98.5%) provable claims (theorems, lemmas, propositions, corollaries) carry full Lean proofs (sorry-free); the remainder bear the sorry marker against an explicit bibliographic reference. The paper poses 85 primary open conjectures of its own—famous external open problems it connects to, and conjectures conditional on those primaries, are tallied separately—of which 75 (88.2%) are class-axiomatised in Lean using the conditional-class convention. This allows downstream results to persist as fully verified conditional theorems. All computations—braid-word reductions, Gröbner–Shirshov normal forms, linear programs, hyperbolic volumes—execute symbolically in the substrate parameter q and attach as witnesses to their supporting proofs. The Rust and Python implementations, alongside the Lean sources, reside at https://github.com/litlfred/qou. Large language models assisted the drafting and formalisation process, necessitated by a physical disability preventing sustained typing and deployed for Lean proof engineering. Human adjudication remains incomplete.
